text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Subglottic Stenosis. The clinical picture of stridor and wheezing worsening with crying and neck flexion, combined with recurrent vomiting (likely due to airway compression affecting the esophagus), strongly indicates a narrowing of the airway below the vocal cords.
